mapper.sql: r.dcr06_relate_doc_type_id AS relate_doc_type_id, r.dcr06_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id, r.dcr06_doc_type_id AS doc_type_id, t.dcr05_title AS title, COALESCE(r.dcr06_default_yn, 'false') AS default_yn, r.dcr06_note AS note

SELECT FROM dcr06_relate_doc_type r, dcr05_doc_type t WHERE r.dcr06_relate_doc_type_id = #{relateDocTypeId} AND r.dcr06_doc_type_id = t.dcr05_doc_type_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dcr06_relate_doc_type (dcr06_relate_doc_type_id, dcr06_class_tree_id, dcr06_doc_type_id, dcr06_company_id, dcr06_note, dcr06_default_yn) VALUES (#{relateDocTypeId}, #{req.classTreeId}, #{req.docTypeId}, #{companyId}, #{req.note}, #{req.defaultYn})
